operations.summary: Single-statement dual-column increment of balance_dollars and balance_cents for one wallet.
Backfill balance_cents from balance_dollars via SELECT ids then per-row UPDATE balance_cents=(balance_dollars*100).

conflicts.risk_explanation: credit does balance_cents=balance_cents+amount while resync blind-overwrites balance_cents=(balance_dollars*100). If resync computes from stale dollars it discards a concurrent increment; on unbackfilled rows NULL+amount stays NULL, so final cents can be NULL, stale, or inconsistent with dollars.

resync reads balance_dollars to derive balance_cents while credit increments balance_dollars. A stale read of dollars propagates an old value into cents, leaving cents behind dollars even when dollars itself includes all credits.

tests.name: credit_vs_resync_on_null_row
tests.rationale: Migration leaves balance_cents NULL; credit does cents+amount which stays NULL on unbackfilled rows while resync overwrites cents from dollars. Interleaving a credit to a NULL row with resync of that row checks whether the increment is lost or left NULL.

invariants.description: cents must equal dollars*100 after backfill and credit

tests.name: two_credits_vs_resync_consistent_row
tests.rationale: Resync overwrites cents from dollars while credits add to both. Distinct credit amounts make each increment distinguishable; a stale dollars read by resync would discard one increment and leave cents inconsistent.

invariants.description: cents must include both credits and match dollars*100

tests.name: stale_rows_full_resync_with_credits
tests.rationale: Both rows start stale (cents 0). Resync SELECTs ids then updates each row separately, so a credit can land before, between, or after the two per-row UPDATEs. Final state must have both rows consistent with their distinct credits.

invariants.description: w1 cents resynced and include credit
w2 cents resynced and include credit

tests.name: concurrent_dual_writes_same_wallet
tests.rationale: V2 credit updates both columns in one statement. Concurrent credits to the same wallet test atomicity of the dual write; a lost update would leave dollars or cents short of the summed increments or break the dollars*100 correspondence.
